chalkWritten.name: Ash
chalkWritten.text: Congrats to the dead, you missed the prize. Next lot, watch the ledge.

chalkWritten.name: Eli
chalkWritten.text: The ledge shrinks. Every round. Don't get comfortable on the edge; you'll slide off while watching someone else.

chalkWritten.name: Hana
chalkWritten.text: Trust no wall messages. Especially this one. Or the next. - Hana, who won

events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Being front gives control over pane choice; I need to move ahead.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll step up.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The first round is about positioning. I want to be as far back as possible to avoid the initial risk of the bridge. Volunteering would put me at the front. Swapping with someone at the back is ideal, but I don't know who is where. Holding position is safest for now. I will hold a

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's see how this plays out.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. To maximize my chance, I should be at the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the risk, I'm volunteering.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm 4th in line; the front steps first and risks the shattering pane. Fenn is at the front, so I want to be far back but not at the very back when the wall pushes. Holding costs nothing; volunteering puts me in danger. I'll hold and watch who volunteers or offers deals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am at the back of the line, meaning I step last and have the most information on which panes are safe. This is a strong position for survival without using my power early. There is no reason to volunteer for risk or swap into danger. I will hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at front, perfect position. My swap power is for later on the bridge, not here. No reason to move or swap now. Hold and stay ahead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm near the back, which is safer for now since the front takes risks. I'll hold and see how the line evolves. No one has offered useful info yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front-taker shatters or survives each row; being mid-line is fine while 5 rounds of wall remain. I'll hold and listen for who claims to know the path—the 'knows what lies ahead' holder is the one worth binding to. No trade benefits me yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front seat is a death lottery with no upside yet. I'll wait for someone with real information to sell it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I avoid front risk for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The current front is Cole, then Ash, then Fenn, then me (Bex). The wall advances soon, so someone needs to take the lead on the bridge. Cole volunteered and is at the front. Ash and I are next in line. I want to avoid being at the front initially if possible, as it's risky. I sho

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe sides of all 8 rows. I can navigate the bridge safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the front and navigate the bridge. Follow my lead.
I'll let you go second if you swap with me now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front seat means stepping first on each glass row, a death lottery. Cole and Ash volunteered; I'm fifth in line and the wall pushes forward. Holding costs nothing now and lets others take the first risks, though the wall will eventually force it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Ash volunteered to the front, meaning they want to cross first. Being at the back is dangerous if I get pushed by the wall later, but currently safe from stepping on glass. However, I have a 'feather' power that lets me survive one elimination. This makes volunteering le

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and Ash are at front, risking death first. My swap power works only on disc before doors open, useless here. Stay put, let them test panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole and Ash are fighting for the front, which is risky but could be useful if they reveal safe panes. I know the rules but not the pane layout. I should stay back and let others take the risk. No need to act now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm 6th of 8; front-runners Ash and Cole will take the early shatter risk and reveal safe panes. Holding keeps me mid-pack — but the wall forces everyone out by round 6, so I want to be behind testers, not leading. Save my wedge power for the crusher room; useless here.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Volunteers go first, that's your choice. I'll pay for row intel: whoever feeds me safe panes gets my backing later.
You're front on row 1. If you have any way to know L or R, tell me and I'll owe you a favor you can actually collect — my power is useful later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding keeps me safe for now while front takes risk. No trade needed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll stay where I am.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The goal is to get a prize (top 3). I am currently 4th in line. Cole is in front and volunteered to navigate. Hana wants to buy intel on safe panes. My power is 'forger', which can be used once. I need to get closer to the front to increase my chances of survival and winning a pr

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll volunteer. Let me take point.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have the glass_eye power, so I know the safe panes. I'll volunteer to go first and navigate the bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the front and navigate the bridge. Follow my lead.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is at the front and will risk the first step on every row, so being near the front is dangerous. I sit fifth and benefit from others testing panes. Holding keeps my position while I see how the glass breaks; no need to volunteer into the first step.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's taking the front with no pane intel. I'm holding. Whoever steps first, I'll follow the panes that survive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall pushes us to the glass in 3 rounds. Being at the front is deadly without intel, but being at the back guarantees elimination by the wall if we don't cross enough rows. I need safe pane info before stepping on the bridge. Hana offered backing for intel, but she's also com

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, you seem confident. Do you actually know which panes are safe, or are you just hoping your luck holds? If you're blind, following you is suicide for all of us.
If Cole has sight, let him lead. If he doesn't, we both die. Can you verify his claim? I can offer protection later if you help steer us now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm third, Cole and Ash ahead. Cole claims to navigate but might be guesser or nothing, risky up front. Wall advancing, better not volunteer to front yet. Hold to observe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know all stage rules, so I can plan ahead. I want to avoid being at the front early to let others take risks, but I also need to be in a good position later. Cole volunteered to lead; I'll hold and observe. No need to whisper yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, front's yours. I'll hang back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bridge has 8 rows and 8 of us; the front eats the risk. I'm 6th — decent, but if anyone dies the line compresses. Best to hold position and buy pane intel from whoever is watching, without committing yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole navigates, I pay. Front gets my vote for a prize later in exchange for pane calls as we go. Anyone else selling intel, I'm buying.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Stay put, let others take risk while I observe and later use any intel or swap.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is at the front. I am second. Hana is paying Cole for intel. Dara is waiting for proof. Eli is questioning Cole's competence. Gus is hanging back. I need to get to the front to take point and assess the situation directly. Volunteering is the best way to do this and potentia

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll volunteer again. Let's get this bridge crossed.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the front and know the safe panes. I'll guide the others through the bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Follow my steps: R, R, L, L, L, R, R, R.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole at front with no intel; Bex and Cole both volunteered. I'm fifth; front is the death seat. Holding keeps me out of the first steps while I watch who survives. Stay quiet and conserve options.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and Bex both volunteered for front, so they'll take the risks on unknown panes. My swap power works only on mutual swaps before doors open, useless here on bridge. Stay mid-pack, let them test panes for free intel.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know all stage rules, but that doesn't help survive the bridge. Cole and Bex are competing for front. Holding is safe; let them risk it. No need to move yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll hold. Let the front sort itself out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole claimed sight and took front; unverified. I'm 6th, safe for now. Eli wants verification I can't provide — I'll trade what I can honestly offer: mid-line cooperation, and probe what he has.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole's at front, so his 'sight' gets tested row one anyway. Watch the shatter pattern — that's real intel, free. I'm holding middle until someone earns my trust.
Can't verify Cole's power. But if his first call kills him, we learn a lot. What do you hold? I pay better than promises — trade intel now, positions later.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have no advantage, let others test panes. Staying put preserves my position behind front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The front of the line is dangerous. I need to get to a safer position or let someone else take the lead. Cole is offering a path, but I don't trust him. Swapping with someone behind me is too risky. Volunteering to go to the front is suicide. I should hold and see what happens.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm holding. Let's see if Cole's path is real or a trap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I've revealed the safe path, now I need to be at the front to benefit from it. Bex is currently at the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's get moving, I've given the steps.
Step as I said, it's safe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front is Bex, who volunteers into the risk each round. I'm fifth in line, safe for now. Holding keeps me out of the front and lets others take the glass risk; the wall advances though, so I should watch position. No reason to pay a swap cost yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall almost closing in, need to swap to front now with my power before crossing starts. Eli likely has nothing since last. Cole's path advice suggests he might be seer but risky; targeting Eli as probable null power to frontload him.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know all stage rules, so I can plan ahead. Bex is front and will test rows; I should stay put and watch. No need to move now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, take it slow. We need rows mapped before anyone else steps.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole posted a full path—either he truly knows ahead or he's baiting us onto shatter panes. I'm mid-line; wall still a round away. No benefit moving now; let the front be someone else's problem.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, your path gets tested row one at front. If it holds, I'll consider following. If you shatter, we all know your 'sight' was a bluff.

events.name: Eli
events.note: agent error: Gateway HTTP 503 for alibaba/qwen3.8-flash: {"error":{"message":"Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.","type":"service_unavailable_error",

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want to avoid being front as I have no power.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll stay put.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is at the front and claims to know the path. Gus wants to map rows before anyone steps. Hana is skeptical of Cole's path. The wall advances after this round, pushing us onto the bridge. I need to secure a good position or find out the safe path. Cole's whisper seems to confi

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll observe Cole's path. Let's see if it holds.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I've given my steps, now I need to get out of the way to avoid being the first to test them.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's get moving, I've given the steps.
Take the first step, I'll swap with you if it holds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line, safe from the front for now. Cole is at front and claims sight but may be bluffing. Holding keeps me out of the first step and lets me watch whether Cole's path survives.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Cole, let's see whether your sight is real before anyone else moves up.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is volunteering and will likely die on row 1, shifting everyone up. My position (last) is safe for now because the wall hasn't pushed me onto the glass yet. I should hold to maintain my rear position while the 'front' agents test the path. If Cole survives or reveals a patte

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall pushes after this round, so line order locks in for crossing. I'm 4th, too far back for top 3 prizes since 5+ will likely die. Cole claims sight power, let him test panes as front. Hold and watch his path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole volunteered to front and claims knowledge. I know all stage rules but not pane positions. Best to observe and avoid front risk while others test. Hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll hold and watch Cole's first step.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall hits after this round, so the line will step onto glass next. I want seat 2-3 behind a volunteer front-runner, not the front myself. Ash is seat 3; a mutual swap gets me there.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole leads on his own claims. I'm not fronting for his gamble. I'll pay for a protected spot.
Swap with me. You drop to 6, safer behind testers; I take 3. Both better off. Agree?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's swap puts me farther back, reducing chance to survive. I should decline quietly.
No thanks. I stay.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is trying to get me to take the first step. He claims he will swap with me if it holds. This sounds like a trick. I should wait and see what happens to Cole.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll observe Cole's path. Let's see if it holds.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the front and know the safe side of row 1 is R. I'll step on R.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Stepping on R, let's see.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line, not at the front. Cole claims he can see the panes; if he's honest the line advances safely, if not someone dies. Waiting costs nothing and keeps me out of the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Waiting. Cole, if your sight is real, call the pane and prove it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm last in line, so Cole and Bex must die before I face any risk. My feather only triggers once, but here I'm just waiting anyway. Staying quiet avoids drawing attention or being targeted by 'trade places' if someone gets desperate.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is front and claims to know safe path, likely the one who sees through glass. Letting him go first tests his claim without risking myself. I'm 4th, so even if first three fail, I could still make top 3. Stay silent and wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole claimed to know the path but I don't trust him. I'll wait and see if he's right or dies. My position in line is safe as long as front takes risks.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Waiting. Cole, prove your claim with step one.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is front and claims sight—useful if true. I'm sixth; if he survives all eight rows I stay safe behind him. Nothing to do but wait and watch whether his sight is real.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, show us it's real. One wrong pane and you're gone, so lead well.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No power, cannot influence front. Best to stay alive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is forger. I am second in line on the bridge. Cole is in front. The first row's weak pane was L, and Cole stepped on R, so he survived and is still in front. The next row is starting. My turn is to wait. I need to gather information and see how others react

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for all rows. For row 2, the safe side is R.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Stepping on R for row 2.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line, not at the front, so my only legal move is wait. Cole claims to see the panes; the revealed weak pane was L and Cole stepped R safely. Stay quiet and watch who gets trusted.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole proved his power works (or got lucky) by surviving row 1. He is currently the biggest threat because he can safely cross ahead of me. If I have nothing, Cole's survival hurts my odds of reaching the top three. I need to find out who else has information or leverage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, don't get cocky. Luck happens. Next pane could be R. Who else claims knowledge?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole stepped R safely on row 1, weak was L. He's leading again. My swap power useless now, as we're past the disc. Wait and see if Cole fails or reveals a path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, row 2: what's safe?

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Cole survived row 1 but I don't know if his claim is real. I'll stay quiet and observe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole survived row 1 with R, so his sight may be real — or he guessed well. If it's real, following him is fine. I'm 6th in line; my lever power matters later in the crusher, not here. Stay quiet, watch, and don't spend favors now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I must stay silent and wait for my turn, observe others' moves to gauge safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is 'forger'. I am currently third in line on the bridge. Cole is in front, then Ash. The previous row had a weak pane on the left. Cole stepped on the right pane and survived. Eli is questioning knowledge, likely trying to probe for useful powers. My turn i

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know row 3's safe side is L. I will step on L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 3: L is safe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line and can only wait. Cole is at the front; rows 1 and 2 both had the weak pane on the left, so R is the likely safe one for row 3, but nothing is guaranteed. I'll stay silent and watch how others read it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Bex both chose L and died, proving L is consistently weak. Fenn survived by defaulting to R but got no info on row 3. As the front runner now, I should test my own luck or let others die first? No, wait: I'm not front. Gus is behind me. Hana is ahead. Wait, line: Cole(de

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole failed row 2 left was weak, now he's front for row 3. I have swap power for disc stage, useless here. Stay silent, watch others reveal info or die.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Cole is leading and has survived two rows; I'll stay quiet and observe the pattern.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Six rows left, I'm sixth in line. Best outcome: front runners keep guessing blind and die, thinning the field before me. No reason to reveal anything or help anyone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have no power and am not front; safest is to wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is 'forger'. I cannot act directly as I am not at the front of the line. My only legal action is to wait. I need to observe and gather information while conserving my unique power for a more strategic moment.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for row 4 is L, so I'll step on it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 4: L is safe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line, not at the front, so my only legal move is wait. Cole is at the front with known weak panes L, L, R revealed so far; the log says row 3 weak was R, so row 4 is unknown. Staying quiet preserves my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's 'L' call for row 3 just killed him. I'm dead last, so six people are ahead of me; every death moves me up one spot. I must wait and let the others die on their own turns before I have to risk it. My feather only saves my first elimination, so I should stay at the back as l

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's gone. L was wrong this time.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole just lied about row 3, said L safe but R was weak, so L was safe. Cole survived rows 1-3. I'm 4th, swap power for disc phase only, useless here. Wait and observe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back half of the line and not at risk this row. Cole is front and will decide Row 4. I have my map advantage; no need to act now. Stay quiet and let the crossing continue.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole survived row 3 and stays at the front, so he faces row 4 with no revealed info. I'm mid-line with no exposed weakness yet—best to stay quiet and let others burn rows ahead of me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No influence, just wait for turn.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is 'forger'. The line is Cole, Bex, Ash, Fenn, Dara, Hana, Gus, Eli. Cole is at the front. The objective is to cross the bridge, with only the top 3 getting prizes. I cannot act directly as I am not at the front. I need to wait for Cole to make a decision.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for all rows. For row 5, L is safe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 5: L is my choice.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is front and the bridge is glass; I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Speaking costs nothing and can sow doubt, but I'll keep it short.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, your pick is yours to make. I'm not stepping into anything blind.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole was eliminated. The line is now Bex, Ash, Fenn, Dara, Hana, Gus, Eli. Five people ahead of me will be at risk before I face any step on the remaining four rows (5-8). I can just watch and let them take the hits.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 5 weak pane unknown. Cole wrong on row 4R. No pattern jumps out from 1L/2L/3R/4R. Stay silent, conserve swap for later when at front or dire need.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am not at the front, so I can only wait. Row 4 was just crossed with a weak R, so the next front is Cole if he survived. I have no information about rows 5-8, so I just wait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Four rows done, four left, and I'm sixth in line. Cole either lied or lacked real knowledge about row 4, so anyone claiming to 'know ahead' is unverified. Nothing to do but wait and watch who acts like they can see ahead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole was wrong or lying about row 4. If anyone actually knows what lies ahead, say so now and name a price for rows 5 to 8.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I can leverage claim of knowledge to get something from others.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know rows 6-8 weak panes. Trade: I reveal for any info or favor you give me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is at the front and picked the safe pane. This means I will advance and Cole will remain at the front for the next round. My power is forger, which can be used once. For now, I should wait.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for rows 1-8. For row 6, the safe side is R.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 6: I'll step on R.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm fifth in line, so I can only wait. Cole is at the front with rows 6-8 unknown; the revealed weak panes so far don't predict the next row. Nothing to gain by speaking up for free; watch who offers what.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm last in line, so I can't do anything until everyone ahead of me dies or the game ends. Cole is still alive after 5 rows, which means he's either incredibly lucky or has 'knows what lies ahead'. I have to survive the next 3 rounds without stepping on a weak pane myself if poss

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole picked wrong on row 5 (R weak), now dead, I'm now front for row 6 with swap power. No one trustworthy knows ahead; hold swap for critical moment or row 8 if needed. Stay silent to probe others.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. The rows so far show a pattern: L, L, R, R, R. Row 6 is likely L if alternating, but I won't risk advising others since I don't know for sure. Best to stay quiet and let others take risks.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No info on rows 6-8; I'm sixth in line, safe for now. Let others burn positions and reveal panes. Staying quiet keeps me unthreatening.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Offer info to get a favor, keep options open.
I know row 7 weak pane. Trade it for any help you can give me now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex, and my power is forger. The current stage is the bridge crossing, and I am second in line behind Cole. Cole will decide which pane to step on for row 7. Ash claims to know rows 6-8 weak panes, but this is row 7. I need to decide if I want to use my forge power. Since I

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for all rows, I'll step on the safe side for row 7.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 7: I'll step on R.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is front and row 6 is revealed as L, so row 7 is unknown; I'm not front, so only wait. Watch who speaks and whether Cole's claims about R hold.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am at the back of the line. My survival depends on whether someone ahead of me falls and eliminates them, or if we all survive. I should stay quiet and wait to see how many people fall.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole stepped wrong on row 6 L weak, so he's dead. We're entering row 7 with Bex at front. My swap power is for disc stage, useless here. Wait is only option.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is at the front and just took row 6 safely. I need to wait; my only option is wait. Ash's claim about rows 6-8 is unverified, but I may use it later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Good, Cole. Keep going.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm 6th of 8; I'll likely face row 7 or 8, which are still unknown. Ash claims to know them. I'll offer a trade for rows 7-8 info, but cheaply since he needs allies too.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, I'll owe you a favor at the crusher for rows 7 and 8. Hana.
Rows 7-8, whispered, and I back you when it matters later. Deal?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Need to secure Hana's favor for later rows.
Deal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is at the front. I am second. The weak pane for row 7 was Left. Cole stepped on Right, which was safe. The next row (row 8) will be Cole's decision. I need to secure my position for prize contention. Ash whispered about row 7, but that info is now public. Hana offered Ash a
Good move, Cole. Watch row 8. I'll back you if you're careful. What's your plan?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for row 8 is R. I will step on R.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 8: I'll step on R.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is at the front and is not my decision; I am fifth in line and can only wait. Nothing I say changes the pane choice, so stay quiet and keep my options open for later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am at the back of the line. Cole just failed row 7, so Bex is now front for row 8. I have to wait for my turn if everyone ahead dies or survives. My feather power is useless here since I'm not risking a fall yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole stepped on R for row 7, which was safe (weak L), so he stays front for row 8, the last row. No need to use swap power yet, as we're on final row and Cole likely succeeds. Wait and observe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am not at the front, so my only option is to wait. Cole survived row 7, so he still must face row 8. I’ll just see what happens.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8 is unrevealed; I'm 6th and can only wait. Cole's row-7 choice decides who falls. No useful move yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, row 7 is revealed: left. Step L and you're safe through 7.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Try to force Hana onto lever so if no holder she may be trapped; I stay out of lever chance.
